system.flavor:
Bite through a rope or a leather strap, tear a sack open, strip the hide from a carcass, gnaw through a thin wooden bar, or drag a sled by a strap in your teeth.

Not enough to bite through iron or hold someone who is fighting to get free.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Piercing Damage. If the target is already Slowed, pull it 1 unit.

surges.html: Suppress one ordinary Poison penalty on yourself until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Adaptation - Predator
rider.html: Assume Serrated Jaw (upkeep 0): your first Gestalt hit each turn against a creature that is Prone can move it 1 unit toward you.
